author: TeIq
content: Delivered: ModeratorAuth trait + ModeratorAuthCtx + Role enum. OidcAuthVerifier with openidconnect 4 (PAR + PKCE + token exchange + user-info). SessionStore with Polaris-issued opaque 256-bit-entropy session IDs + AES-256-GCM-sealed refresh tokens + monotonic-nonce-free seal/open primitives. Tower middleware extracts cookie + attaches Extension<ModeratorAuthCtx>; healthz + OIDC callback exempted. Cookies HttpOnly + Secure + SameSite=Lax. Postgres-backed sessions survive restart. Mock-OIDC integration test exercises the full code-exchange flow. Session-expiry test covers expired-lookup + refresh-rotates + revoke-returns-not-found. SQL-injection test fires 9 hostile payloads through SessionStore::lookup, asserts InvalidToken every time, asserts the malicious bytes do not leak to tracing. Migration adds moderators / moderator_roles / sessions / auth_oidc_login_states with pgcrypto extension for cross-version portability. .sqlx/ cache populated with 10 entries; SQLX_OFFLINE build verified.
